known.via: English Wikipedia "Hawke’s Bay wine region" (redirects to "Hawke's Bay wine region")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: One of New Zealand's oldest wine regions and its second-largest, on the North Island's east coast. Vineyards sit on the plains and low hills around Napier and Hastings. Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc lead at 22% each, with Merlot at 20%, so reds and whites both matter.
